info.title: DMA / Knowledge Weaver shared memory contract
info.description: Implementation specification only. Source of truth proposed at knowledge-weaver/contracts/v1; DMA vendors a checksummed release. Default transport HTTP over owner-only Unix socket, not a TCP listener. X-DMA-Client is a trusted local installation binding, not a cryptographic identity or hostile-tenant boundary.
